readerQuestion: How can a Home Assistant countdown survive a restart, including when its deadline passes while the server is off?
selectedBecause: Current exact-query searches still surface outdated restoration workarounds alongside the current Timer documentation. A February 2026 Community question and a June 2026 Reddit discussion independently repeat the need for restart-safe countdowns. The useful gap is distinguishing restored countdown state from a missed completion event, then showing an explicit overdue policy. This is a reusable local-automation problem, not another protocol variant. Community interest establishes recurrence, not search volume; no recent surge is asserted. Historical constraints: seo/search-performance-2026-09-15.json was parsed using a JSON parser; completed reporting cutoff is 2026-09-13. Site Chart totals for September 7-13 are 3 clicks/216 impressions versus 2/231 for August 31-September 6. The 92-day June 14-September 13 page rows for unavailable-after-restart (4 clicks/768 impressions) and automation-not-firing (2/559) are cumulative ownership context, not recent demand. Relevant visible queries include automation quick-action errors and tiny one-impression rows; none justifies a topic pivot. Page sums and query sums are not site totals. seo/search-console-review-2026-09-15.json confirms homepage, IKEA direct-pairing, Bluetooth proxy and main-LAN/IoT-VLAN indexed on September 15; some newer guides remain discovered/not crawled and wake-up light was unknown. Deployment and accepted requests do not prove indexing or recovery. seo/recovery-review-2026-09-15.md and seo/search-change-review-2026-09-15.md show broad historical losses across devices/countries and changed/unchanged HTML, without establishing a causal title effect. seo/analytics-measurement-contract.md was read; no GA4 event or customer inquiry data was used. Keep one-new-page maximum, stable strategy and established owners.

searchReview.intent: Keep a countdown and its intended completion behavior through a Home Assistant restart, deciding what happens if its deadline is missed.
searchReview.resultGap: Exact-query web search returns current Timer docs, older community restore-timer workarounds and for-duration questions. Timer docs correctly disclose the missed-finish limitation; the missing integrated homeowner procedure is choosing an overdue policy and implementing saved date+time plus pending status, startup and periodic checks. Direct Google review was attempted at https://www.google.com/search?q=Home+Assistant+timer+survive+restart but returned HTTP 429 and a challenge. Accessible search-tool results were reviewed instead; no Google rank positions or volumes are claimed.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant Timer
officialSources.supports: Restore active and paused timers; no timer.finished event is replayed at startup for expiry during downtime; idle also means canceled or never started.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant automation triggers
officialSources.supports: for-duration reset on restart/reload; date-time helper time triggers, startup trigger and periodic time pattern.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant Input Datetime
officialSources.supports: A date-and-time helper stores an absolute deadline; set_datetime accepts timestamp; state restores unless an initial value overrides it.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant Input Boolean
officialSources.supports: Pending toggle stores whether completion is still wanted and restores its prior state unless initial is configured.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant script syntax
officialSources.supports: Separate start sequence and short completion actions; conditions, templates, variables and action ordering.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant state and time templates
officialSources.supports: has_value rejects missing, unknown and unavailable entity states; current state_attr and now documentation support the deadline comparison with a safe numeric fallback.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant Persistent Notification
officialSources.supports: Create a local frontend notification with a fixed notification_id to update the same message; not a phone push.

officialSources.name: Home Assistant automation troubleshooting
officialSources.supports: Traces and Run actions checks; manual action execution does not test trigger scheduling.

existingCoverage.decision: Inventoried all article titles and all existing topic-brief questions plus keyword strategy/map before selection. General trigger diagnosis, outage capabilities, repeating door alerts, vacation routines and low-battery maintenance keep their owners regardless of index status. This article specifically implements persisted countdown completion and overdue behavior. The candidate intent gate passed. Separate refresh opportunities, not edits in this job: review the general automation-not-firing page's restart section for a concise saved-deadline next step; review door-left-open restart caveats for an appropriate link only if readers need a fixed deadline. Recent guides are linked only for a real next question. The library supplies reachability; extra links are not a guarantee of indexing.
